title.t: Model accuracy has improved over time.

steps.t: Accuracy on both labels climbed from 27% for GPT-4o in 2024 and 59% for GPT-5.2 in 2025 to 91% for present-day frontier models.
Closed-weight models consistently outperform open-weight models. The best open-weight models still trail, with Kimi K3.1 Pro reaching 63%.
steps.src: paper/sections/03_rq1_ai_vs_human.tex (Figure 2 caption, then the RQ1 timeline paragraph)

steps.t: Frontier models are competitive with trained detectors such as Pangram 4 at prose detection.
On idea detection, they exceed the accuracy of IdeaLens, the only existing state-of-the-art idea detector.
